key_findings: R-8HDA-modified Schwann cell mitochondrial EVs escape lysosomal degradation and suppress macrophage TNF-α/NF-κB inflammation.
In vivo R-MitoEVs lowered TRPV1 and CGRP and alleviated osteoarthritis-associated neuropathic pain.
